entries.en: to shoot arrows on foot (estando a pie)
to shoot arrows on horseback (a caballo)
phlegm; phlegm hawked up from the throat (gargajos)
entries.notes: M 栏音写为三音节（sām lō tām），与 H 栏单字「痰」不一一对应，疑有衍写；释义据 L 栏 flemas/gargajos 与汉字互证。

entries.en: phlegm accumulated in the chest; chest congestion

entries.zh: 干癣，手足部干燥癣疥之疾
entries.en: dry tinea; scurfy, scabby eruption of the feet or hands
entries.notes: 西语 flemasalada 疑为 flema salada（旧医学「咸痰」致癣疥之说）连写讹；释义据 H 栏「乾癬」定。

entries.en: ulcerated, running sores on the arms and hands
entries.notes: 首字原件标[疑]（覽/攬），西语 nsteledamado 疑为讹写；据「爛」与 delos braços y manos 定为臂手溃烂。

entries.zh: 无紧要，不要紧、无关紧要
entries.notes: 西语 enpugestas 无法对应、疑为讹写；释义以 H 栏「無緊要」为主要依据。

entries.zh: 心冷，灰心丧气、心灰意冷
entries.en: disheartened; heart grown cold, languid in action
entries.notes: 西语 flematicos in execucion 与「打心冷」对应较间接，据痰滞心冷、行动倦怠之意释义。

entries.zh: 揽心性，心性拖沓懒散宽缓
entries.notes: 首字「攬」与西语 espaçioso 的组配属推断，据第 13–15 条同组「痰缓宽懒」系列词义释义。

entries.zh: 驾船，行船；雇船、租船载运
entries.en: to charter or freight a vessel; to sail or pilot a boat
